name: blinkit-quick-commerce-scraper
title: Blinkit Quick Commerce Scraper - Products & Prices
description: Collect public Blinkit product data by search and location with clean titles, brands, prices, MRP, discounts, pack sizes, ratings, image URLs, and product URLs.

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged when the run starts to cover browser startup and the residential proxy session. Number of events depends on memory (one per GB, minimum one).

product-scraped.eventDescription: Charged once for each clean Blinkit product saved to the dataset.
